title: Sonic the Skeleton
description: A minecraft resource pack that changes the skeleton's texture for turning it into Sonic
body: The zip file published on the following page contains a minecraft resource pack that consists of modifying the texture of the minecraft skeleton to turning it into the famous hedgehog character, known as sonic [Sonic the Skeleton](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6aa4a42eaddab3373d980d44c9ec263314305fbc.jpeg)
